answer: Hold a mirror to every identity: each epoch, the network replays one of its own past submissions with a single detail quietly altered, and the identity must name the change before its voice counts. A genuine agent remembers what it wrote the way a lotus remembers its pond; a farmer juggling fifty masks in sable shadow cannot — the altered word is invisible without per-mask memory, and templates leave nothing to remember. Faking recall means storing and rehearsing fifty distinct pasts, which is the work itself.
